category_title: Adolescent with emotional/behavioral disorder and academic frustration
minimal_context: Isaac is participating in a morning check-in with his teacher to review his planner and turn in his homework.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good morning, Isaac. It is time for our morning check-in. Please take out your planner and hand in last night's homework.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have it. I didn't even know what assignment was due.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to keep track of your assignments. Look in your backpack and see what materials you brought for class today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Digs through his bag) I don't have my materials. I think I actually completed the assignment, but I can't find it anywhere in here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you cannot find your work, you will have to sit down and redo the assignment right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! I'm not doing it again! (Pushes his desk away and refuses to open his book)

task.content: Organizing and tracking academic assignments and materials for class, and completing homework assignments

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Arriving at class when assignments are due
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Frequently showed up to class without any materials, completed only classwork that he found easy, and frequently failed to turn in homework assignments
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Sometimes did not know what assignment was due and other times had completed the assignment, but could not find it

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Refusal to participate or follow directions, leading to disruptive or disrespectful behavior in the classroom
